svg.aria-label: TrustLens Contracts: PaymentGate on Base Sepolia. Pay per scan at 0.0005 ETH, or a thirty day pass at 0.005 ETH. Built, deployed and dark while the scanner is free.
svg.title: TrustLens Contracts
svg.desc: PaymentGate is the on-chain payment layer for the TrustLens scanner. It offers a single scan for 0.0005 ETH and a thirty day unlimited pass for 0.005 ETH, is deployed to Base Sepolia at 0x93F37c9af6b4dB4c51DD3CD1a742a4D9AdC878Ca, and is unaudited and switched off while the product is in free beta.
